features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lift device connected to a vacuum tank and pump, not a cordless handheld device with integrated battery power.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: I attach a thick strip of medium soft rubber 45 to channels 2| and bars 32 by a metal strip 46 and screws 47 and 48 respectively. A strip of hard rubber 49 is interposed between the rubber strip 45
features.note: The reference describes a 'thick strip of medium soft rubber' forming a sealing edge, which is flexible and forms a seal. However, it is not described as a 'lip on a suction cup' but rather a strip attached to the frame.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: A pipe I6 connects the tank I2 to a vacuum 10 pump Il,
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum pump that draws air, but it is connected to a tank and not described as being mounted within a rigid body of a handheld device.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference does not mention any pressure sensors or means for monitoring the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or mechanisms for monitoring vacuum levels.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning thresholds or vacuum monitoring.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or their behavior.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum pump connected to a tank, not powered by an integrated rechargeable battery.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lift device that is lifted by a hoist, indicating it is not a single-hand portable design. It also mentions external piping for vacuum.

overall.why: This reference describes a vacuum lift device for sheets of material, which is in the same broad area as the subject invention. However, it is a large, hoist-operated system with external vacuum components, lacking the portability, integrated power, and safety features of the subject invention.
